items.summary: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. items.title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
items.summary: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. items.summary: A coding agent working within a software organization must establish what to build, collaborate with colleagues, and verify what it delivers. items.summary: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. items.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
items.summary: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers.

items.summary: Harness optimization is often studied with a fixed policy model and benchmark. items.summary: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. items.title: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
items.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. items.summary: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. items.summary: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. items.summary: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect.
